# TS01-A — Stage-1 admin orchestration

## What it is for

The administrative entry points for Stage 1 — genesis wiring, protocol switches, and the operations only the governance key may run.

Talos is **the only supported client path**. Core modules build an unfinished bill that only Talos may settle, and the gas station sponsors **only** shapes it recognises. A core client function called directly would not have its gas paid and could not collect.

## Where it sits

Above every Stage-1 core, below nothing.

## Traps

**Admin operations are gasless by exemption, not by skipping.** They run the collection path exactly as a client does; it is simply served by the one account the collector exempts. The source is precise about why: *the path is preserved, not skipped; that is what makes an admin call gasless.* A skipped path is untested.

**That exemption was once far wider** — it asked whether the payer was any smart account, and anyone may create one. It now names a single constant.
